observations.statement: All81 authorized committed receipts resolved:77 successes,4 execution failures. All successful validations contain3,234,051 impressions. The latest pair both succeeds; no missing metric is treated as a performance negative.

Latest M AUC0.6151265165838878 exceeds N0.6151021885074872 by0.000024328076400625953; Logloss0.19653102114657658 is lower by0.0000015627888446667626. This is one successful run per source at the same declared seed, below the historical AUC maximum.

Both jobs report schema5,64 scalar diagnostics,14,661 training calls through checkpoint,16,385 category rows and131,073 brand rows. All four valid_probe flags equal1. At both slots raw repeats, fixed-role/fixed-gradient repeats, no-op/guard/live-bridge/observer/step failure checks report zero.

Original role-sum repeat relative distances are nonzero in both arms at both calls: M7.083304915213946e-7/7.630341035067736e-7; N5.743082539920285e-7/6.919766689677188e-7. Fixed-tree role repeat distances report zero.

M original-repeat active-gradient relative distances are5.012468626672756e-9 and1.1786649023183592e-8; fixed-versus-original distances6.054681415992946e-9 and1.2778505057715173e-8. N active-gradient distances report zero despite its inactive role-sum variation.

At call512, M original-repeat and fixed-versus-original represented Adam parameter-update absmax distances both equal1.4901161193847656e-8. At call8192 both are zero. M first/second-moment distances are nonzero at both calls; N gradient, moment and update distances are zero at both.

Clone-only positive sensitivity checks report nonzero gradient, first moment, second moment and update changes in both arms/slots. Update min-table absmax ranges0.0019915103912353516 to0.0031608417630195618. These large-perturbation checks demonstrate nonconstant measurement response, not calibrated sensitivity to every tiny perturbation.

The fixed-tree path remains a diagnostic shadow. The latest experiment does not replace aggregation during complete training, and does not compare final predictions under original versus fixed aggregation.

N reproduces aggregate AUC/Logloss and all23 slice dictionaries from round24/25 none controls. This does not prove identical predictions or hidden states. Latest M changes sign versus N compared with prior negative diagnostic replays. A blanket claim that all later diagnostic M runs lose AUC is now false.

The historical M AUC maximum0.6152795936767026 remains an observed receipt. Its exact-source replay scores0.6149279138846995; earlier source-stratified magnitude duplicates also vary. Latest small positive contrast is not reproduction of the original score or a repeated same-source performance gain.

Static/pooled/target-aware reference AUCs are0.6050036144838207/0.6102261137080656/0.6133619861190683. Full count-correction loses in pooling and target-aware models; half correction helps pooled AUC but loses target-aware AUC. These are successful negative/mixed experiments.

Same-field products outperform ordinary products locally; aligned normalized products outperform crossed products. Constant/history-mean alternatives nearly match fuller normalization; combined half routing outperforms either single-role half route. These contrasts retain several plausible scale/conditioning explanations.
Direction-only, rotated-magnitude and uniform-energy controls lose AUC to none. Raw-gradient controls do not match actual Adam update directions/energy; no semantic-conflict attribution follows.

Four trace-v1 jobs fail before validation with the recorded float32/64 support error. Their receipt wall sum is21.4754219353199 seconds. Original offending tensor/dtype and null training costs remain unknown; later successful instrumentation does not erase them.

Latest pair has equal learned capacity17,130,275 parameters, including17,078,688 embedding and51,587 dense. Receipt wall sum1439.49970446527 seconds, known training sum1259.17585234344 seconds. Equal capacity/data passes do not establish equal compute.
